issue.symptom: The macro's Input and Output tunnels were disconnected (empty body); the output exec pin showed 'Exec 2'.
issue.ue_message: no error; reported from UE editor screenshot

root_cause.direct: Builder intentionally left the macro body unwired (documented 'manual' step); input exec 'Exec' + output exec 'Exec' collide because macro signature pin names must be unique, so UE renamed the output to 'Exec 2'.
root_cause.generator_layer: No reusable accessor to reach macro tunnels for body wiring; the earlier decision treated tunnel-pin wiring as too fragile to automate.
root_cause.ir_layer: expected_ir declared the macro body as MANUAL/empty, diverging from a complete test asset.

affected_patterns.pattern: Generated macro graphs left with empty bodies / colliding exec pin names

fix.strategy: Add reusable FBPGen::GetMacroInputTunnel/GetMacroOutputTunnel; auto-wire BP_05 macro body (Concat(Prefix,Message) -> PrintString.InString; In exec -> Print -> Out exec); name the output exec 'Out' to avoid the 'Exec 2' collision.

validation.known_unrelated: BP_05 compile_status=warnings due to a PRE-EXISTING 'ReturnNode Exec pin has no connections' warning in a function graph (present before this change); deferred per user (other tests later).
ue_manual_check_required: BP_05: confirm Macro_LogWithPrefix body Input->Append/Print->Output and output exec named 'Out'

next_user_action: Optionally instantiate Macro_LogWithPrefix in a graph for MacroInstance coverage
